run_process_cc_news: run the CC-NEWS preprocessing script to convert gzipped JSON news articles into tokenized training shards
run_process_file: run process_file to read gzipped JSONL news files, filter English articles, and create tokenized output blocks
create_blocks_from_plain_text: create blocks from plain text lines by tokenizing and chunking into fixed-length sequences for model training
save_flatten_data: save flattened JSONL output where each line is a single tokenized sequence with its metadata
save_nested_data: save batched nested JSONL output where each line groups multiple sequences by key for efficient loading
